x: Five, taken before the awrād. The Durood Naqshbandia is recited before and after the daily exercises; these stand at the threshold in the same way.
Ṣalāt li-sh-shifāʾ · for health
Mujaddid Alf Thānī, Shaykh Aḥmad Sirhindī · d. 1034 AH / 1624 CE

اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَاشْفِنِي وَبَارِكْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدْ، اَللَّهُمَّ اشْفِنِي بِصَدَقَةِ صَلَوَاتِكَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدْ، اَللَّهُمَّ اشْفِنِي بِصَدَقَةِ سَلَامِكَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدْ، اَللَّهُمَّ اشْفِنِي بِحُرْمَةِ بَرَكَاتِكَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدْ، اَللَّهُمَّ اشْفِنِي وَقَوِّنِي وَصَحِّحْنِي وَاجْعَلْنِي طَوِيلَ الْعُمْرِ بِحُرْمَةِ سِرِّكَ الَّذِي بَيْنَكَ وَبَيْنَ مُحَمَّدْ

Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā Muḥammadin wa-shfinī wa bārik ʿalā Muḥammad. Allāhumma-shfinī bi-ṣadaqati ṣalawātika ʿalā Muḥammad. Allāhumma-shfinī bi-ṣadaqati salāmika ʿalā Muḥammad. Allāhumma-shfinī bi-ḥurmati barakātika ʿalā Muḥammad. Allāhumma-shfinī wa qawwinī wa ṣaḥḥiḥnī wa-jʿalnī ṭawīla l-ʿumri bi-ḥurmati sirrika lladhī baynaka wa bayna Muḥammad.

O Allāh, bless Muḥammad and heal me, and grant grace to Muḥammad. O Allāh, heal me by the alms of Your blessings upon Muḥammad. O Allāh, heal me by the alms of Your peace upon Muḥammad. O Allāh, heal me by the sanctity of Your blessings upon Muḥammad. O Allāh, heal me, strengthen me, restore me sound, and grant me length of life — by the sanctity of Your secret that is between You and Muḥammad.
Sayyid aṣ-Ṣalawāt · the master of blessings
Shaykh ʿAbdullāh al-Fāʾiz ad-Dāghestānī · d. 1973 CE
عَلَى أَشْرَفِ الْعَالَمِينَ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ الصَّلَوَات عَلَى أَفْضَلِ الْعَالَمِينَ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ الصَّلَوَات عَلَى أَكْمَلِ الْعَالَمِينَ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ الصَّلَوَات
ʿalā ashrafi l-ʿālamīn sayyidinā Muḥammadin iṣ-ṣalawāt ʿalā afḍali l-ʿālamīn sayyidinā Muḥammadin iṣ-ṣalawāt ʿalā akmali l-ʿālamīn sayyidinā Muḥammadin iṣ-ṣalawāt

Upon the Noblest of all Creation, our Master Muḥammad, blessings. Upon the most Preferred of all Creation, our Master Muḥammad, blessings. Upon the most Perfect of all Creation, our Master Muḥammad, blessings.

صَلَوَاتُ اللهِ تَعَالَى وَمَلَائِكَتِهِ وَأَنْبِيَائِهِ وَرُسُلِهِ وَجَمِيعِ خَلْقِهِ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَيْهِمُ السَّلَامُ وَرَحْمَةُ اللهِ تَعَالَى وَبَرَكَاتُهُ. وَرَضِيَ اللهُ تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَى عَنْ سَادَاتِنَا أَصْحَابِ رَسُولِ اللهِ أَجْمَعِينَ وَعَنِ التَّابِعِينَ بِهِمْ بِإِحْسَانٍ وَعَنِ الْأَئِمَّةِ الْمُجْتَهِدِينَ الْمَاضِينَ وَعَنِ الْعُلَمَاءِ الْمُتَّقِينَ وَعَنِ الْأَوْلِيَاءِ الصَّالِحِينَ وَعَنْ مَشَايِخِنَا فِي الطَّرِيقَةِ النَّقْشْبَنْدِيَّةِ الْعَلِيَّةِ، قَدَّسَ اللهُ تَعَالَى أَرْوَاحَهُمُ الزَّكِيَّةَ وَنَوَّرَ اللهُ تَعَالَى أَضْرِحَتَهُمُ الْمُبَارَكَةَ وَأَعَادَ اللهُ تَعَالَى عَلَيْنَا مِنْ بَرَكَاتِهِمْ وَفُيُوضَاتِهِمْ دَائِمًا وَالْحَمْدُ للهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ

Ṣalawātu llāhi taʿālā wa malāʾikatihi wa anbiyāʾihi wa rusulihi wa jamīʿi khalqihi ʿalā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli Muḥammad — ʿalayhi wa ʿalayhimu s-salāmu wa raḥmatu llāhi taʿālā wa barakātuh. Wa raḍiya llāhu tabāraka wa taʿālā ʿan sādātinā aṣḥābi rasūli llāhi ajmaʿīn, wa ʿani t-tābiʿīna bihim bi-iḥsān, wa ʿani l-aʾimmati l-mujtahidīna l-māḍīn, wa ʿani l-ʿulamāʾi l-muttaqīn, wa ʿani l-awliyāʾi ṣ-ṣāliḥīn, wa ʿan mashāyikhinā fī ṭ-ṭarīqati n-Naqshbandiyyati l-ʿaliyyah — qaddasa llāhu taʿālā arwāḥahumu z-zakiyyah, wa nawwara llāhu taʿālā aḍriḥatahumu l-mubārakah, wa aʿāda llāhu taʿālā ʿalaynā min barakātihim wa fuyūḍātihim dāʾiman. Wa l-ḥamdu li-llāhi Rabbi l-ʿālamīn.

Blessings of God (Exalted is He), of His angels, of His prophets, of His Emissaries, and of all creation be upon Muḥammad and the family of Muḥammad; may the peace and mercy of God (Exalted is He) and His blessings be upon him and upon them. May God, the Blessed and Most High, be pleased with every one of our Masters, the Companions of the Emissary of God, and with those who followed them in excellence, and with the early masters of juristic reasoning, and with the pious scholars, and the righteous saints, and with our Shaykhs in the exalted Naqshbandī Order. May God (Exalted is He) sanctify their pure souls and illuminate their blessed graves. May Allāh, the Exalted, always bestow upon us their blessings and bounties. All praise is due to Allāh, the Lord of the worlds.

An addition to the ṣalawāt of Sayyidinā ʿAlī. It was given by Sayyidinā Muḥammad ﷺ in a vision of Shaykh Sharafuddīn ad-Dāghestānī qaddasa’llāhu sirrahu , who said: reciting it even once in a lifetime is heavier than the whole of creation standing twenty-four hours in ṣalawāt and repeating it all their lives — this ṣalawāt will be heavier on the Scale than all of their ṣalawāt combined.
Ṣalāt al-Khuṣūṣ · the particular blessing
Mawlānā Shaykh Nāẓim ʿĀdil al-Ḥaqqānī · d. 2014 CE
اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدْ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامْ صَلَاةً تَدُوْمُ وَتُهْدَى إِلَيْهِ، مَا مَرَّ اللَّيَالِي وَطُوْلَ الدَّوَامْ
Allāhumma ṣalli wa sallim ʿalā nabiyyinā Muḥammad ʿalayhi s-salām, ṣalātan tadūmu wa tuhdā ilayh, mā marra l-layālī wa ṭūla d-dawām.

O Allāh, send Your blessings and peace upon our Prophet Muḥammad, upon him be peace — a blessing that endures and is conveyed to him as a gift, for as long as the nights pass and the whole length of everlastingness.
Yā Aḥad yā Ṣamad · the seal of the Qudsiyya
Mawlānā Shaykh Nāẓim ʿĀdil al-Ḥaqqānī · d. 2014 CE
يَا أَحَدْ يَا صَمَدْ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدْ
Yā Aḥad, yā Ṣamad, ṣalli ʿalā Muḥammad.
O Unique, O Eternally Besought — bless Muḥammad.
Subhanım Allah · the Turkish ṣalawāt
Mawlānā Shaykh Nāẓim ʿĀdil al-Ḥaqqānī · d. 2014 CE
سُبْحَانِمْ الله، سُلْطَانِمْ الله، نَبِيمْ مُحَمَّدْ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامْ
Subhanım Allah, Sultanım Allah, Nabim Muhammad Aleyhissalam
My Glorified One is Allāh, my Sultan is Allāh, my Prophet is Muḥammad — upon him be peace.
Spoken in Turkish, not Arabic: -ım and -im are the Turkish first-person possessive, so each phrase says my . The Arabic script above is the Ottoman spelling of the Turkish, not an Arabic translation.
Five ṣalawāt, before the awrād.
